hints.content: We have two tapes that are the same length. Let's start by writing an expression for the length of each tape.
The top tape has a length of $25$ units.

The bottom tape has two parts, one with a length of $x$ units and the other with a length of $13$ units.

The total length of the bottom tape is $x+13$ units.

So, the tape diagram shows us $25=x+13$.

The section labeled $x$ is $13$ units shorter than the $25$ unit long tape.

$x=25-13=?$
